$comment: Every feedback loop the Lycheetah engines claim, with where it closes. Audited against the source by loop_audit.py: symbols must exist, closes_in_code must equal what the syntax tree shows, and every reader of an open loop must be listed. Read CYBERNETIC_READING.md for the argument; this file is the evidence.
author: Mackenzie Conor James Clark / Lycheetah Framework

vocabulary.sensor: what reads the essential variable, and through which channel: state (the system's own variables), text (surface features of language), self_report (numbers a person types in), caller_supplied (numbers handed in by whoever calls)
vocabulary.comparator: what holds the reading against a setpoint
vocabulary.actuator: what changes the world in response; null when nothing in code acts
vocabulary.closes_in_code: true when the actuator's effect reaches the sensor's input inside the code; false when a person, a host model, or nothing at all must finish the loop
vocabulary.known_callers: for open loops: every file that references the class, as censused 2026-10-03. A reader of an open loop is where the loop might close.

loops.name: Grey Mode recovery
loops.essential_variable: psi_r: the recovered state's drift from the invariant anchor (TRIADKernel.detect_drift)

actuator.who_acts: code: TRIAD correction cycles on the quarantined node's state

loops.cybernetic_role: complete negative-feedback regulator: sense drift, compare to threshold, correct, sense again; alert_threshold=2 debounces activation
loops.note: The one loop in the framework with all four parts in a single class. The setpoint adapts to network statistics (compute_r_merge), so it is an error-controlled regulator with a moving reference, not a fixed thermostat.

loops.name: contradiction-driven reorganisation
loops.essential_variable: active contradictions between universal-regime blocks in the same domain

comparator.setpoint: truth pressure Π ≥ 1.5 FOUNDATION, ≥ 1.2 THEORY, else EDGE; trigger_margin 0.3

actuator.who_acts: code: demotes the old block to regime 'qualified', divides its uncertainty by compression_gamma, promotes the new block to 'universal', reassigns layers

loops.cybernetic_role: double loop in Ashby's sense (INTERPRETIVE): the first loop sorts each block by Π threshold; the second fires only when the first meets a contradiction it cannot hold, and reorganises the structure the first loop runs on
loops.note: Closes across calls, through shared state: the actuator writes .regime, which the sensor reads on the next block. The 'environment' is the incoming block stream, not a world. Known weakness: the event field demotion_correct re-checks the filter that built the conflicts list, so it cannot be False.

loops.name: scalar coherence ascent
loops.essential_variable: Ψ: a scalar state whose coherence C(Ψ) is supplied as a function

comparator.setpoint: argmax C(Ψ), reached when the gradient vanishes

loops.cybernetic_role: gradient-following regulator; sensor and actuator are the same method (read the gradient at self.state, write self.state)
loops.note: The loop is real and closed, but the landscape C is handed in by the caller. TRIAD regulates toward whatever goal it is given; it does not choose the goal.

loops.name: anchor-ascent-fold correction

actuator.who_acts: code: anchor → ascent → fold on a state vector

loops.cybernetic_role: fixed-point iteration; the actuator's output is the sensor's input and the next iterate. Grey Mode recovery is built on this kernel.
loops.note: Annotation defect: the signature says Tuple[ndarray, int] and the docstring says (state, iterations); the function returns a 3-tuple (state, iterations, errors).

loops.name: phase synchronisation
loops.essential_variable: pairwise phase differences; summarised by the order parameter r

actuator.who_acts: code: each oscillator advances its own phase from the coupling sum

loops.cybernetic_role: mutual feedback without a setpoint: synchrony is an attractor of the coupled dynamics, not a target anyone holds
loops.note: Closed in simulation only. Applying Kuramoto coupling to AI agents or human-AI dialogue is CONJECTURE; nothing in the repository measures it.

loops.name: constitutional check
loops.essential_variable: intended: whether an output preserves human primacy, reversibility, honesty and the other invariants. Measured: regular-expression cues in the output's text, plus optional context['human_capabilities'].
loops.who_acts: whoever calls check(): a person, a host model, or a wrapping system
loops.cybernetic_role: sensor and comparator only. By design: the verdict is handed to a human or host model, which is where this loop closes.
loops.note: The sensor reads a proxy (words) for the essential variable (effects). Conant–Ashby: a regulator is only as good as its model of the system. The context['human_capabilities'] channel is the existing seam toward a sensor that reads effects.

loops.name: TES / VTR / PAI check with VIP repair
loops.essential_variable: trajectory stability (TES), value transfer (VTR), purpose alignment (PAI)

actuator.who_acts: nobody in code: apply_vip returns template text and check() never calls it

loops.cybernetic_role: sensor and comparator with an actuator stub
loops.note: The nearest thing in the repository to an actuator for AURA-family checks, and it is a text template. Closing it in code means a caller that applies the repair and re-checks.

loops.name: intention-action drift
loops.essential_variable: the gap between intended and actual hours, |intended − actual| / 24, as typed in by the person
loops.who_acts: the person who reads the report and changes their day
loops.cybernetic_role: a mirror, not a homeostat: it shows drift; a human is the actuator
loops.note: Its only reader imports it and never instantiates it: sovereign_pipeline.py recomputes a drift inline in stage 4.

loops.name: sovereign pipeline CASCADE → TRIAD → AURA → MICROORCIM
loops.who_acts: nobody in code: a breach appends a flag to the result
loops.cybernetic_role: feedforward chain: each stage feeds the next; nothing the last stage measures returns to the first
loops.note: Until 2026-10-03 run() raised AttributeError on every call (it called TriadTracker.run, which does not exist) and no test exercised it. Repaired the same day, with tests/test_sovereign_pipeline.py. The MICROORCIM stage is inline arithmetic, not a MicroorcimTracker call.
